name: Apollo.io
tagline: AI GTM platform unifying prospecting, enrichment, outreach, and deal execution.
description: Apollo.io is a unified AI go-to-market platform combining a B2B database of 230M+ contacts and 30M+ companies with multichannel outreach, data enrichment, inbound routing, and deal-execution tools like AI meeting prep, call summaries, and conversation intelligence. It serves 600,000+ companies and replaces several point tools in the sales stack.
insight: Raised a $100M Series D in Aug 2023 led by Bain Capital Ventures at a $1.6B valuation.
edge: Pairs a 230M+ contact database with outreach, enrichment, and deal tools and a real free tier — the most accessible self-serve all-in-one of the group.
